name: Virtual Multi-Resolution Volume with Page Table Hierarchy
aliases: Virtual Multi-Resolution Volume with Hierarchical Page Tables
Virtual Multi-Resolution Volume Representation with Page Table Hierarchy
definition: A virtual memory architecture for out-of-core volume visualization that replaces tree structures (octrees/kD-trees) with a virtual multi-resolution volume addressed via normalized coordinates and translated to physical cache blocks via a hierarchy of page tables.
summary: A virtual memory architecture for out-of-core volume visualization that replaces explicit tree structures with a recursive page table hierarchy to manage arbitrary, axis-dependent resolution levels efficiently.
